agents.home_title: BoonBuy haul math — weigh the parcel before you click ship
agents.home_h1: BoonBuy is a first-haul freight notebook, not a generic agent portal
agents.lead: This site only covers BoonBuy. It does not rank other agents and it does not send you through a shared product grid. The useful question on a first BoonBuy order is volumetric: shoe boxes and winter jackets eat dimensional weight faster than the item price suggests.
agents.angle: New-user shipping off (up to 30%) plus invite G8ZWVJI95 only matters after you know the line's weight break. BoonBuy users who skip that step treat the coupon as a discount on a number they have not seen yet.
agents.warehouse: Park goods in BoonBuy's warehouse until the haul is dense enough that one outbound parcel beats three thin ones. Do not assume unlimited free days — check the current storage clock in the BoonBuy app before you let a haul sit through a sales week.
agents.qc: BoonBuy QC photos are a go/no-go gate, not a fashion lookbook. Reject on glue stains, asymmetry, and size-tag mismatch before you submit the parcel. Re-QC costs time; shipping a reject costs more.
agents.who_not: Skip BoonBuy if you need same-week branded triangular shipping paperwork or if you only buy from one domestic boutique. It is a China marketplace agent (Weidian / Taobao / 1688), not a US return desk.
faq: Does the 30% shipping offer apply to every line?
No. Read the BoonBuy coupon drawer for the line names it actually attaches to. Volumetric lines and private lines are often excluded.
When should I ship vs wait?
Ship when added storage fees would exceed the extra freight of a second parcel. That crossover is haul-specific; this page does not invent a universal day count.
Is this BoonBuy.com?
No. Independent notes for people already using BoonBuy. Register on BoonBuy itself with G8ZWVJI95 if you want the invite attached.
agents.start_title: First BoonBuy order — submit, QC, then pick a line
start_steps: Create the BoonBuy account from BoonBuy's own register URL and attach invite G8ZWVJI95 before the first payment.
Paste the marketplace link (Weidian / Taobao / 1688) into BoonBuy submit. Do not rewrite the seller SKU.
Wait for warehouse photos. Check measurements against the seller's size chart, not against a generic US size.
Only then open shipping quotes. Apply G8ZWVJI95 / new-user freight off on a line that lists the coupon as eligible.
Declare the commercial value your destination customs process asks for. This site does not coach under-declaration.
agents.ship_title: BoonBuy lines: dimensional weight first, ETA second
agents.ship_body: Compare BoonBuy lines by the heavier of actual kg vs volumetric kg. A US EMS-like product and a EU-tax-inclusive product are not interchangeable just because both say 8–12 days. Open the live quote in BoonBuy for the destination postcode; screenshots on other blogs go stale when fuel surcharges move.
ship_points: Weigh the packed haul in BoonBuy before you lock a coupon.
Tax-prepaid EU lines cost more up front and reduce surprise bills later.
Sensitive goods (batteries, liquids) silently drop you onto a slower line.
agents.coupon_title: BoonBuy codes that actually attach: G8ZWVJI95
agents.coupon_body: The invite G8ZWVJI95 is a registration attachment, not a stackable storewide percent. Pair it with BoonBuy's current new-user freight drawer. If a screenshot says 30% off everything, ignore it — open the coupon list inside the logged-in BoonBuy account.
offers: Up to 30% on eligible lines — confirm in-app

agents.who_not: If you need same-day outbound or you refuse to hold goods, EastMallBuy's storage story is wasted. Use an agent that prices speed, not dwell time.

An EastMallBuy register attachment. Add it on their register page, not as a freight coupon at checkout.
Do points expire?
Points and giveaway coupons follow EastMallBuy's own wallet rules. This hub does not invent expiry dates — open the wallet.
Why isn't there a 10,000-product catalog here?
Because copying the same SKU list onto every agent domain is the thin-affiliate pattern. Use EastMallBuy search.

Submit links as they drop; do not wait to discover a seller before creating the order.
Mark each inbound as hold until the haul list is complete.
QC as photos arrive. Exchange at the warehouse while the rest is still inbound.
One outbound parcel. Apply wallet coupons only on the quote screen that lists them.

agents.qc: If the ¥1000-class coupon is merchandise-only, a QC reject that you still ship wastes the coupon on goods you will not wear. Cancel or exchange first.
agents.who_not: If you hate reading coupon constraints, GTbuy's stacked welcome package will feel broken. It is not broken; it is conditional.
faq: What does 2×30% mean?
Two shipping-off events or a doubled window — confirm inside GTbuy. It is not 60% off one line.
Where does P8C60T0D7 go?
GTbuy register inviteCode. It is not the ¥1000 coupon code.
Can I use this site as a GTbuy clone of other agent blogs?
No. Only GTbuy wallet mechanics live here.

Clip the ¥1000-class coupon in the GTbuy wallet and read its minimum subtotal.
Submit marketplace links. Do not split one seller's set across two orders if the coupon needs a single subtotal.
QC, then pack.
Open freight quotes during the 30% window and only on eligible lines.
agents.ship_title: GTbuy freight after the merchandise coupon is spent

ship_points: Eligible lines are listed in the GTbuy coupon detail, not on this page.
Doubled 30% windows expire; screenshot the end date.
Private lines often sit outside welcome freight deals.

agents.qc: Welcome stacks create pressure to “use it before it expires”. That is how bad pairs get shipped. Expiry is not a reason to GL.
agents.who_not: If you only needed a 15% freight code and not a layered wallet, the ¥5290 headline will distract you. Read each coupon's type field in GoatedBuy.
faq: Is ¥5290 one code?
Usually a pile of smaller coupons. GoatedBuy's wallet lists the split.
Does 15% hit freight?
Only if that coupon's type says shipping and the line is eligible.
Same HTML as GTbuy?
Not anymore. GTbuy is a ¥1000 + double-30% story. GoatedBuy is a large fenced pile.
start_steps: Register via the GoatedBuy hash URL with invite-code=mwrnen.
Open the wallet. Note which coupons are goods vs freight vs expired.
Submit links that can actually consume a goods coupon (minimums).
QC without panicking about expiry; RL if needed.
Pack, then apply freight 15% only on eligible GoatedBuy lines.
agents.ship_body: Quote after packing. If the 15% coupon is shipping-typed, it still may exclude private lines. The ¥5290-class goods coupons will not subtract from this freight screen.
ship_points: Type field in the wallet is law.
Hash-router invite must survive the first load.
Expiry ≠ GL.
